collection.title: Maserati GranCabrio 2010 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Maserati GranCabrio 2010 to 2019 model requires a 26” wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Push Button attachment.
